text: Hi! I found your app on X, and I really love the Material 3 design! The animations are also really well done. Good job 👍 I hope the frequency settings can become a bit more flexible. Currently, habits can only be scheduled for specific days of the week, but I’d love to see an option to repeat a habit every X days. Thanks for all your work on this app!
author: Veronica
developer_reply:
Hello Veronica!
We appreciate your review.
A lot of new features are coming soon. Stay tuned!
